name: Parcelus Minor
description: Parcelus Minor was a planet in the Expansion Region. Its small amount of landmass was almost entirely covered with swamp jungles; the natives of the planet spent much time simply pushing the edge of the swamp back. All plant life on Parcelus Minor exuded tzeotine, a combustible resin used by the native population for heating and fuel.
